ritual: Read this file first, then A2A.md and docs/HARDWARE.md.
Work, run the gates, commit with measurements, update this file in-file.
rules: The firmware is scripture: if it looks wrong, our reading is wrong.
Measure before patching; the compiler and the run are the judges.
Read PDFs as rendered pages with vision; OCR text is only an index.
Model the silicon, not the firmware's minimum. An unmapped register is a recorded gap.
Use absolute Windows paths with the drive colon for file tools.
Do not copy code from Prehistoricman/TMS57070: it has no licence.
Decoded firmware stays in rom/, outside git; regenerate it with the decoder.

paths.sheets: service manual PDF pages 2-17: sheets 01/15 to 15/15 in order; render with PyMuPDF (fitz) and read as images

gates.decode_pass: exit 0; every file shows size-check ok and checksums == message count
gates.run_master_pass: no STOP line; UART2 sends bytes; flash shows sector erases; LCD writes 37381 or more
gates.presets: extract the presets zip to rom/presets_mid, then python tools/ob12_sysex.py rom/presets_mid/*.mid -o rom/presets
gates.run_slave_pass: no STOP line; UART2 Master shows 11 and the version text
gates.core_compare: build/core_compare.exe rom/dsp 2000 (needs a local public emulator copy)
gates.run_system: OB12_DIRECT=3 OB12_POT_SWEEP=14 build/ob12_system.exe rom 21 16 build/final.wav, then python tools/analyse_wav.py build/final.wav 19 20.8
gates.tone: OB12_MIDI_EVENTS=13:pc:10 OB12_AUX_TONE=400000 OB12_BUS_TONE=1 build/ob12_system.exe rom 19 15 build/tone.wav, then python tools/tone_junk.py build/tone.wav: junk below -50 dB on both sides
gates.dsp_bench: build tools/dsp_bench.cpp with build/tms57070.obj and /Ibuild; dsp_bench rom/dsp 0, 1, 4: 'same state' (FA417F6D, 356212FB, 77E99AC1), translated halves 390625, single steps 0
gates.build_order: build_master.bat (runs gen_fast.py), build_engine.bat, build_pgo.bat, build_engine.bat, build_vst3.bat
gates.same_as_before: build/fm/ab.sh: eight seq_test scenarios against a kept old seq_test; MD5s must match (keep an old seq_test.exe before changing the cores)
